subsection: Secundum secretam doctrinam sapientum Hebraeorum Cabalistarum
latin_incipit: Nulla res spiritualis descendens inferius operatur sine indumento.
latin_full: Nulla res spiritualis descendens inferius operatur sine indumento.
english_translation: Nothing spiritual, descending below, operates without a garment.
english_full: Nothing spiritual, descending below, operates without a garment.

scholar_citations.work: Pico della Mirandola's Encounter with Jewish Mysticism
scholar_citations.quotation: All the peculiarities of the Masorah represented mysteries of the ten sefirot, a discovery Pico made through Recanati's commentary.

scholar_citations.work: Magic and the Dignity of Man: Pico della Mirandola and His Oration in Modern Memory
scholar_citations.quotation: The sefirot form a ladder of mystical ascent: from Kingdom (Malkuth) through nine higher emanations to the Infinite (Eyn-Sof).
